name: Sangam India Ltd
title: Sangam India Ltd - 514234 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record Q4 FY26 (INR880cr revenue, INR33cr PAT) on high utilisation and lower inventory, but management guides no new capex benefit until FY28 and FY27 growth is "similar" to FY26 top-line.

utilisation.quote: we are at highest capacity utilizations compared to the last six to eight quarters

capex.quote: we'll probably take a quarter or something to plan further that what we want to do over the next couple of years

triggers.label: Yarn utilisation ~95%
triggers.quote: capacity utilizations are high. So that has led to the volume

triggers.label: Finished goods inventory cut over 4-6 quarters
triggers.quote: Continuously we are we are ramping up capacity and reducing our finished goods.

triggers.label: Renewable power ~15% to 70%+ by June 2027
triggers.quote: Probably I think in a year's time, let's say June next year is when we expect that about 70% plus of our power will be renewable.

triggers.label: New capex deferred; benefits from FY28
triggers.quote: any kind of new capex growth, any the benefits for that will probably start flowing from next year. Nothing in this year for sure.

guidance.quote: let's say June next year is when we expect that about 70% plus of our power will be renewable
the cumulative benefits to the EBITDA once everything is commissioned would be about INR50 to INR60 crores annually
We aspire to do that again in FY '27. I use the word aspire deliberately

guidance.value: Similar to FY26 growth, no abnormal growth
guidance.quote: top line, I think growth will be similar to what we did last year

guidance.value: Maintain or better March quarter margins
guidance.quote: we should be able to maintain or better our margins from the March quarter for sure

red_flags.label: Debtor days elevated vs two years ago
red_flags.quote: our debtor numbers are still elevated in terms of number of days compared to two years ago

red_flags.label: Management avoids specific spread and per-kg numbers
red_flags.quote: I do not have that handy now. I'm sorry.

red_flags.label: Raw material inventory rising ahead of orders
red_flags.quote: we have more coverage of raw material than the finished good orders in hand

evasions.topic: Yarn spreads per kg and quarter-on-quarter movement
evasions.quote: I do not have that handy now. I'm sorry.
So I don't have anything concrete to say now, but there will be something
I'm not actually aware of where the customer count has gone down.
